input: Arrange a group hiking day for the team

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The number of attendees and their physical fitness levels directly determines which trails are suitable and how the group should be managed on the day.
Whether this is purely a recreational social event or also has a team-building/work objective changes how it should be structured and communicated.
The target date and geographic location constrain which trails are accessible, what weather to expect, and how much lead time exists for planning.
Whether there is a budget (for transport, catering, equipment hire, etc.) determines what options are feasible and who covers costs.
How the group gets to the trailhead — own cars, hired transport, public transit — is one of the most complex coordination challenges and must be resolved early.
The desired difficulty and style of hike (leisurely walk vs. challenging trail, scenic vs. adventurous) affects trail selection and the overall feel of the day.
Knowing what the organiser considers a successful outcome — maximum participation, positive feedback, staying on budget, etc. — helps prioritise planning decisions.

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a group hiking day for the team
gold.taskDescription: Plan and organise a full group hiking day outing for a team, covering everything from choosing a trail to coordinating attendance and logistics.

questions.title: How many people are in the team?
questions.description: Establish the expected headcount so that trail capacity, transport, and catering can be planned appropriately.

questions.title: Is this a social outing or a structured team-building event?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose of the day to determine whether any facilitated activities, goals, or work-related framing need to be built into the plan.

questions.title: What date and general location are you targeting?
questions.description: Pin down the when and where so that trail research, weather considerations, and lead-time planning can begin.

questions.title: Is there a budget, and who is covering the costs?
questions.description: Determine the financial envelope and whether the company, individuals, or a mix will pay for transport, food, and any entry fees.

questions.title: How will the group travel to the trailhead?
questions.description: Decide on the transport arrangement — carpooling, hired coach, public transit — as this is one of the earliest and most complex logistics to resolve.

questions.title: What difficulty level and style of hike do you want?
questions.description: Understand whether the team wants a relaxed scenic walk or a more challenging trail, which directly drives trail selection.

questions.title: What does a successful hiking day look like to you?
questions.description: Identify the key outcomes the organiser cares most about — full attendance, staying on budget, high enjoyment ratings — to guide prioritisation throughout planning.
